name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 31 times in 9 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 60 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2026-01-15, at wavelengths from 1.01 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
